You guys work miracles, so we don't have to dig into our reigning funds, and I know that the next years are going to be very challenging, and we're going to have to make some serious decisions about the future of our finances within the city, and also as Council Member Ed Prince mentioned, the challenges that our community also are going to be facing after this pandemic, so looking forward to coming back to this table and have more discussions about what we can do with the money that we have. Council Member Coleman said one day that we are not a rich city, but with what we have, we are trying to do wonders to really serve the best quality services to our constituents, and the intent is there and want to put the money where is the most need for our community, so I very much appreciate it. The goal of this vote was to prioritize and budgeting around equity, racial equity in our community, and I very much appreciate that.
